story.titleZh: 哈贾尔因手腕伤势未愈缺席意大利大奖赛
story.summaryZh: 红牛车队确认，伊萨克·哈贾尔因手腕伤势尚未康复，将缺席本周末的意大利大奖赛。

detailZh: 伊萨克·哈德贾尔（哈贾尔）因手腕伤势将缺席意大利大奖赛，利亚姆·劳森（劳森）将在蒙扎获得红牛的又一次机会
红牛已确认伊萨克·哈德贾尔将缺席意大利大奖赛，因为他的手腕伤势尚未恢复；周五的意大利大奖赛练习赛将于上午11:30和下午3点举行，天空体育 F1将进行直播
回顾一些曾在意大利大奖赛上发生过的最具戏剧性的时刻
哈贾尔 将因持续的腕部伤势错过本周末的意大利大奖赛，劳森 将连续第二站代替他出战红牛车队。
Hadjar 上个月在夏休期间的拳击训练中受伤，这迫使他错过了荷兰大奖赛，他未能及时康复参加蒙扎的比赛。
随着 Lawson 升任 维斯塔潘 在红牛的队友，角田裕毅 将再次有机会在 小红牛 车队中证明自己。

红牛直到周三下午才做出决定，只为给哈贾尔（Hadjar）一切参赛机会，但医疗团队认定他应再缺席一场比赛，并希望他能参加下周末在马德里举行的下一站比赛。
红牛车队表示：“利亚姆（Liam）将在蒙扎的意大利大奖赛上与马克斯（Max）并肩出战，而伊萨克（Isack）在暑假期间手腕受伤后，仍在继续取得令人鼓舞的进展。”
车队正在密切关注他的康复情况，在他重返赛场一事上不会冒任何不必要的风险，并祝愿他早日康复。
小红牛 车队的利亚姆·劳森（劳森）与天空体育F1的Crofty坐下来畅谈，透露了他会带到荒岛上的那些赛道
哈贾尔（Hadjar）目前在车手积分榜上排名第八，领队洛朗·梅基斯（Laurent Mekies）认为这位法国车手是维斯塔潘（Verstappen）多年来最接近其水平的队友。
红牛尚未确认哈贾尔将继续留在车队参加2027赛季，但这位21岁车手的表现很可能意味着他将保住自己的席位。
在赞德沃特，劳森（Lawson）表现出色，排位赛仅落后维斯塔潘0.1秒，并在荷兰大奖赛上获得第七名——这与他2025年初在红牛两次参赛后被弃用时的表现形成鲜明对比。
角田裕毅在小红牛也度过了一个强劲的周末，他的成绩刚刚排在积分区之外，并且领先于全职车手阿尔维德·林德布拉德（Arvid Lindblad）。

detailEn: Isack Hadjar to miss Italian Grand Prix with wrist injury as Liam Lawson gets another Red Bull opportunity at Monza

Red Bull have confirmed Isack Hadjar will miss the Italian Grand Prix as he's yet to recover from his wrist injury; watch Friday's practice sessions for the Italian GP at 11.30am and 3pm, live on Sky Sports F1
Look back at some of the most dramatic moments to have taken place at the Italian Grand Prix
Isack Hadjar will miss this weekend's Italian Grand Prix due to his ongoing wrist injury, with Liam Lawson replacing him for a second consecutive event at Red Bull.
Hadjar suffered the injury while boxing in training during the summer break last month which forced him to miss the Dutch Grand Prix and he has not recovered in time for Monza.
With Lawson stepping up to be Max Verstappen's team-mate at Red Bull, Yuki Tsunoda will have another chance to impress at Racing Bulls.

Red Bull only made the decision on Wednesday afternoon to give Hadjar every chance to drive but medical staff have decided he should miss another event and hope to return for the following race in Madrid next weekend.
"Liam will drive alongside Max at the Italian Grand Prix in Monza, while Isack continues to make encouraging progress following the wrist injury sustained during the summer break," said Red Bull.
"The team is closely monitoring his rehabilitation and will take no unnecessary risks with his return to competition and wishes him a speedy recovery."
Racing Bulls' Liam Lawson sits down with Sky Sports F1's Crofty to reveal his the tracks he'd take with him to a desert island
Hadjar is eighth in the Drivers' Championship and team principal Laurent Mekies thinks the Frenchman has been Verstappen's closest team-mate for several years.
Red Bull are yet to confirm Hadjar will stay at the team in 2027 but the 21-year-old's performances likely mean he will keep his seat.

At Zandvoort, Lawson impressively qualified only one tenth behind Verstappen and finished the Dutch Grand Prix in seventh - a complete contrast to his two Red Bull outings at the start of 2025 before he was dropped.
Tsunoda also had a strong weekend at Racing Bulls as he finished just outside of the points and was ahead of full-time driver Arvid Lindblad.
